safetyNotes.paymentWallet: Do not change payment runtime in this pass; rollback trigger includes checkout/provider failures or source-of-funds mismatch.
safetyNotes.gumdropLedger: GumDrop pricing and spend math unchanged; verify source buckets after rollback.
safetyNotes.authSession: Auth/session rollback requires login, logout, and protected route checks.
safetyNotes.analyticsIngest: Verify telemetry write path does not block user flows and summary docs remain bounded.
safetyNotes.chatRealtime: Verify chat read/send paths and typed errors after rollback.
safetyNotes.notificationPwa: Verify prompt/token registration does not expose raw tokens.
safetyNotes.adminDebugFallback: Admin debug should show stale/failed labels rather than green fallback.

rollbackProcedure: Revert or reset deployment target to last known good through operator-approved deploy process.
Do not mutate production or provider data during rollback.
Record rollback commit, owner, time, and evidence packet.
postRollbackVerification: Run source checks for beta score and release notes.
Run operator production smoke after rollback deployment.
Verify wallet/payment, GumDrop ledger, auth/session, analytics ingest, chat, notifications, and admin debug states.
